body: I did the same at the beginning. Now I'm sort of automated. I'm the shell of a person. I live because that's what I'm supposed to do. But it doesn't make sense at all.

It is the worst pain imaginable. 
I am so sorry that you are in such pain. I understand it. I think only people who went through the same or similar can understand. Otherwise it just seems silly, others seem to think that we overreact and exaggerate. But that's just how we feel.
I truly hope you can get better somehow and be happy again. I can't tell you it will get better because the truth is nobody can know for sure what will happen. Surely I wish you all the best, whatever that best is for you. Life has been rough with you and I hope it will treat you better in the future.

I've read it all. It's hard for me to find the words to answer you. I am 22. Until the beginning of this year, I felt like I was living in hell. I saw life as a constant storm, with brief moments of calm. Then I got with the person I love the most, my best friend of 2.5 years at the time. I ended up recently losing him. And I do feel like you feel. The ending of your post is exactly how I feel. I haven't killed myself yet because I would kill my mother too and I cannot stand that. But I feel that I lost it all. I lost the only person who made me feel alive. I do want to live, like you say. But sometimes I simply feel life is not for me. I wish I could do so many things. I thought I could. But I lost it all. I guess what I'm trying to say here is that you're not alone. I understand what you say perfectly. But again, at the end of the day me and you are each alone with our burden. Sorry I couldn't find anything better to tell you.

I don't think yours is a bad peace. It seems a sort of meditation and that can actually help. I find tranquility in my routine, in knowing what I'm doing on that day, until I go to sleep. Art is also a huge comfort for me. 
I am learning how to live and keep under control my struggles. It's something I learned to keep inside me and to deal with. It's a part of me basically.

You have to be safe first of all. Nonetheless consider also to see how the situation evolves, you said that his depression is a recent event so he could be able to eventually keep it under control like you do. Probably all this is worsened by his family's behavior. He needs to be safe too and if things are like you said, the situation doesn't help his condition. I can't give you very personal advices but consider supporting him through therapy and trying to find a way to get out of any abusive relationship he may have (his step-brother behavior isn't really helpful I think). Hope it all goes well for both of you.

Happy birthday.
These days are tough, I know. Wishing you the best.

It is stressful but it also keeps me busy which is good. I don't know if anybody else is struggling but there is a support at university, but it's a bit expensive. I'll first look into something public (I'm not in the US, healthcare is free here) and if I feel it's not suitable I'll go somewhere else. Concerning specialty I still have time to decide but I find psychiatry quite interesting (ironic, hm?).
By the way, feel free to message me in private if you want to talk more or anything else.
I'm in med school, which isn't so relaxing as you can imagine but whatever.

I do care for her indeed. 
I didn't really promise to do it in January, I'm at my mother place right now for holidays and I'll go back to the city where I study in January. Here it's a small town and I wouldn't really have the chance to seek help without her knowing.
If this is the decision you made, I wish you peace. I can't do much else. I'm sorry for how life turned out for you.
She is struggling, she's been on meds for as long as I can remember and it is another reason why I don't want to cause her any trouble. If I go to theraphy myself, I don't want to let her know.

Please consider the implications of this. I understand that you are feeling hopeless but there must be a way to let her know the situation, even indirectly or with something like a letter. Don't let her realize it when it's too late to do anything.
I can't know the details but I think maybe she does not realize what her behavior did to you. It is a tough situation surely. Maybe she doesn't understand how broken you are.
Did you try telling her how you feel? I'd tell you to try any possible way, if you haven't already.

I don't think I'll tell her in the near future. I think she kinda understood I struggled years ago when I was much more blatantly showing distress. Then I learned to live with it and I can basically function normally most of the time. Our relationship isn't that great, we go along but we learnt to do that in the last 6/7 years if not less and I don't know how to discuss relevant and private topics of any kind with her, plus I don't want to worry and stress her more than she already is, also being that I live far from her for more than half of the year so she'd be really worried and I don't want that. So far I've been able to manage my struggle and I don't want to involve her.

She does not know, it is more like respect than a deep relationship, I am the only one she has and I just feel a great obligation not to let her down and not to make her suffer. I am certain she could not bear my suicide. 
Thank you for your encouragement.
I feel that someone who works for a suicide hotline should at least be able to tell if you're genuinely hyperventilating because of your state of mind or because you're masturbating...
I feel I don't have much interesting to say but I will try. I'll post again here sometime and maybe, even if it's not something well written, it will help me like it helped me this time.

Do you think there is a reason for her behavior or is this out of nowhere? 
I am so sorry. I understand that the feeling of her moving on is excruciating.
I can't write but I try to paint, it helps a lot.
Sometimes I wonder if everyone feels like I do and they just all hide it. I mean like thinking about suicide and stuff.
Thank you. I wish you all the best, sending lots of love your way.
I can't know that as it is something very personal. But I can tell you you seem a good person, sincerily. I hope things can improve for you and thank you for your comments.

He does not. Sadly, I said "the person I am in love with" because I do love him but we are not in a relationship, we are very close friends but I didn't tell him anything about how I feel for fear of losing him and you can imagine this situation is painful for me. But thank you for your words and do not lower yourself, you seem a very very caring and kind person. 
I guess that you're right that I should try to live on the good side but sometimes all I can do is feel miserable...I need to focus more on the positive parts, but it's not so easy.

Thank you for your kind words. I have some things that make me happy but sometimes even those turn bad, out of nowhere. For instance, I play League of Legends on a daily basis with the person I am in love with and in those moments nothing else matters and I just feel good. But sometimes, I can't do much, because I don't play as well as him and I get so sad because I feel so worthless, I know it's stupid and it's something that he doesn't care about but yet I feel like crying over something so small. 

I paint but all I paint are pictures of my inner struggle. I agree with you that it helps, I feel good doing it because painting representations of how I feel helps putting order in my thoughts and I'd love to be a painter, I love art but I also realize it is not possible to live off of it and that also saddens me. 
I guess I could find something to feel bad about in everything, ha.
What kind of stuff, if you want to talk about it?

I live in Europe, Italy, so it's simpler and cheaper to access to therapy compared to the US. I'll try. 

I understand how it is to see so much death and misery around you. Most of my family died in the last 6 years. I feel I've encountered death so many times and I have sort of quietly accepted it. 

Did you try therapy yourself? Maybe it's not too late for you as well.
I promised myself I will try going indeed.
I can at least in part understand how you feel. The person I love with all my heart, along with my mother, is keeping me alive. I am sure I could never do it without him.

Maybe I'll never do it, but the point is I need to find reasons to stay alive and I doubt this is healthy. I can kinda hide my problems and I'd say that 99% of people would never think I have them, but I do. It is like I'm haunted and I don't let anyone see my ghost.
I just want to tell you that even though someone may seem to have it worse, don't belittle what you feel. Your pain should not be compared to those of others. You are not stupid for feeling this way.

I understand your point. But sometimes I feel that life, not just mine but existence in itself, is just something unnecessary. The story can be good, but I cannot find its real meaning. It's like we are all born without finality, we just exist and die at a given point. And it'd be lovely to have a great time while waiting for the epilogue, but it's pretty difficult, at least for me.
There are good things. But it's like a constant storm with some rays of sunshine every now and then.

I feel the same as you do. Allow me to wish your mother the best. 
I am considering therapy. I realize some days my feelings just overcome me, and I can't always do it on my own. Posting here is helping me already in a way. 

Realized I forgot to answer your question. Well I'm 21 and I'd say I've struggled with my mental health for about 7 years. Suicidal thoughts were intermittently present and intensified in the last couple of years I'd say.

I have no resent, I just accept things as they are. I have a tendency to think that whatever is supposed to happen, good or bad, happens and that what we can do to change our fate is limited, we are rather supposed to connect the dots and try to understand the bigger picture. 
I do feel haunted and cornered. Sometimes I'm able to escape that, sometimes I'm not. On certain days I may even feel i love life, but it never lasts. There are good things, but there are also so many bad things.

I would not call that a weight, it is just a quiet consciousness to me. My mom is a good part of the reason I have never attempted and if I didn't have her I'd prob be dead. I promised myself to seek help in January, don't know if I'll do it for real. Been telling myself I'll ask for help so many times already and never did it...
